ledger.x: 8 September 1278: the first paréage makes Andorra a co-principality.
1278: Andorra is a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia, so under the Crown of Aragon.
1516: the Crown of Aragon passes into the Spanish monarchy and with it the overlordship over Andorra.
1516: Andorra, still a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia, is now the Spanish monarchy's.
1715: the Principality of Catalonia is subdued and Andorra leaves it.
1812: the co-principality ends with the annexation to the Sègre department; the Andorran state is restored in 1814 ('an imperial decree reestablished the independence and economy of Andorra').

wars.name: Peninsular War
wars.outcome: The First French Empire annexed Catalonia in 1812-1813, Andorra with it as part of the district of Puigcerdà; an imperial decree of 1814 restored Andorra's independence.

certainty.note: The History of Andorra page says 'Andorra's borders have remained unchanged since 1278' but no page opened describes a delimitation or survey, so the outline is Cliopatria's one-cell stand-in throughout.
